title: Ring calls off partnership with police surveillance provider Flock Safety - Engadget
summary: Ring canceled its planned integration with Flock Safety, announced in October 2025, saying it would require more resources than anticipated. The partnership would have allowed law enforcement using Flock's Nova/FlockOS to request doorbell videos via Ring's Community Requests; no footage was ever shared and the decision was mutual. The cancellation follows backlash over Ring's Super Bowl Search Party ad.

key_quotes.quote: planned Flock Safety integration would require significantly more time and resources than anticipated.
Flock is known for its automatic license plate readers and for centralizing the information it collects into a database that police can search without a warrant.
